text:
zoe.design: FYI pushed a small PR that tweaks the time-range sampler UX and p95 tooltip copy in the latency dashboard preview. would love quick eyes on accessibility + copy. https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/1159

raj.prod: saw the preview. overall looks tighter. one quick thought on the p95 copy: current says `P95 latency (ms) — sampled` which might be terse/confusing for non-obs users.

zoe.design: yup trying to avoid parentheses. options I'm considering:
- 'P95 latency — 95th percentile response time (ms) (sampled view)'
- 'P95 latency — 95% of requests finish within this time (sampled)'
- 'P95 (95th percentile) latency in ms — sampled'
Which feels clearest?

leah.eng: vote for the second one. plain language is better when customers hover and skim. also dev note: raised the sampler handle min-touch to 40px and expanded hit area, changes CSS and a tiny layout tweak for small panels.

leah.eng: putting the CSS here for reference:
```css
.sampler { touch-action: pan-x; }
.sampler-handle { width: 40px; height: 40px; margin: -8px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 8px; }
```

omar.ml: heads up that increasing the hit area altered the live-snap thresholds on the heatmap. to avoid noisy jumpiness I increased the sampler settle debounce from 60 -> 100ms and added a 6px snap buffer. numbers look stable in A/B.

nina.a11y: a11y points: focus ring color contrast in dark theme still borderline. swapping to #002f6c gives 4.6:1 which meets AA on the current bg. also recommend role="slider" + aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax and aria-valuetext describing current window like "last 15 minutes". finally add visually-hidden label text for screen readers.

zoe.design: thanks @nina.a11y — I'll update the CSS and add aria. for the tooltip copy i'll go with "P95 latency — 95% of requests finish within this time (sampled)" unless anyone objects.

raj.prod: sounds good. please also add a tiny hint under the heatmap: "Sampled view may omit very rare spikes" — marketing friendly and sets correct expectations.

leah.eng: CI build for PR 1159 passed. ci-bot: `build=1159 unit=pass e2e=running`

ci-bot: e2e passed. staging link: https://staging.redwood.ai/console/preview/1159

nina.a11y: quick keyboard walkthrough: tab lands on sampler handle, screen reader now says "time range slider, 15 minutes" after aria text update. good improvement. one more nit: add aria-live polite region for the p95 value when sampling changes, so SR users get notified of new metric values.

omar.ml: added a tiny debounce guard to metrics update to avoid SR spam; 200ms coalescing works well.

zoe.design: great. I'll update the PR with copy + a11y tweaks and add a changelog bullet: "Latency: clarified P95 tooltip, improved sampler touch target and accessibility, and added sampled-view hint."

raj.prod: :shipit: once regression suite is green. thanks everyone for the quick turn.
